relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: mAbs induced a meaningful and sustained reduction in MMDs across three consecutive one-year cycles of treatment

key_findings: Anti-CGRP mAbs reduced monthly migraine days by about 12-13 days across three consecutive one-year cycles in an ITT analysis of 179 subjects.
At the end of cycle 3 the 50% response rate was 38.5%, indicating remaining burden and need for non-CGRP-dependent approaches.
